name: Lack of Surplus
summary: Tok'Kar and the soldiers on the coast are stationed to guard Stonard against murlocs, or to send warning when the force is too large. Tok'Kar wants six sawtooth snapper claws and offers one of the outpost's weapons in thanks.

sections.title: Weapons for the Coast
sections.body: With murlocs a threat along the coast, Tok'Kar and the soldiers are posted here to protect Stonard, or to warn it if the force is too large. That leaves little time for rest, and Tok'Kar could use more help. The claws of sawtooth snappers make fine weapons when properly prepared. Tok'Kar asks for six, and offers one of the outpost's weapons in return, grateful for the meat and the company.

faq.answer: Tok'Kar, who is stationed along the coast to protect Stonard.

faq.q: Why does Tok'Kar need sawtooth snapper claws?
faq.answer: Their claws make fine weapons when properly prepared, and Tok'Kar wants six of them.

faq.q: What threat is the coastal post watching for?
faq.answer: Murlocs along the coast. The soldiers are there to protect Stonard, or to warn it if the force is too large.
